intentAndPurpose.intent: Focused overlay with structured header/body/footer layout and scroll management. The modal popup is role-neutral; per-role styling is applied to the slot children (footer buttons, headerStart, body content).

props.name: children
props.description: Modal body content

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog. Required when `header={false}` or `showTitle={false}` — without it, screen readers announce an unnamed dialog (WCAG 2.1 AA 4.1.2 violation). When the title is visible, Modal wires `aria-labelledby` to <Dialog.Title> and this is optional.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Optional id of an element labelling the dialog. Mutually exclusive with `aria-label`. Takes precedence over Modal's generated Title link.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target for the backdrop + popup. Defaults to `document.body`. Pass a bounded element (with a containing block, e.g. `transform`) to render the modal inside it instead of over the whole viewport.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test id forwarded to the dialog popup

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Default open state (uncontrolled)

props.name: description
props.description: Modal description text

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether Escape/outside press can dismiss the modal. Explicit close controls and controlled parent state changes still work.

props.name: dividerBottomScrollPosition
props.description: Scroll threshold through which the bottom divider remains visible when `dividerBottomVisibility="onScroll"`.

props.name: dividerBottomVisibility
props.description: Bottom divider visibility behaviour.

props.name: dividerTopScrollPosition
props.description: Scroll threshold at which the top divider appears when `dividerTopVisibility="onScroll"`.

props.name: dividerTopVisibility
props.description: Top divider visibility behaviour.

props.name: footer
props.description: Whether to show the footer section.

props.name: footerEnd
props.description: Footer content (typically action buttons)

props.name: footerOrientation
props.description: Footer button orientation.

props.name: footerStart
props.description: Content for the footer start slot

props.name: header
props.description: Whether to show the header section.

props.name: headerAlign
props.description: Header content alignment.

props.name: headerStart
props.description: Content for the header start slot. Renders before the title. Per RFC 0001: presence/absence of the ReactNode is the visibility gate — no enum discriminator needed.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Optional maximum height for the popup. When omitted, the responsive size-specific Figma preset is used.

props.name: modal
props.description: Dialog modality. `true` (default) traps focus, locks page scroll, and makes outside elements inert. `false` keeps only pointer behaviour (no scroll-lock/ inert); `'trap-focus'` traps focus without the rest. Mirrors Base UI's `Dialog.Root` `modal`. Use `false` to render an open modal inside a bounded container (e.g. a preview) without covering the page.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the modal opens or closes. The `details.reason` arg lets you distinguish dismiss triggers (Escape vs outside-press vs close button) and inspect the underlying Base UI event/trigger details.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is open (controlled)

props.name: showDescription
props.description: Whether to show the description.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Whether to show the title.

props.name: size
props.description: Modal size preset. Deprecated uppercase aliases (`S`, `M`, `L`, `FullWidth`) normalize to their canonical lowercase equivalents.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles

props.name: title
props.description: Modal title text

codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage
codeSnippets.code:
import { Modal } from '@oneui/ui';

<Modal title="Modal title">
  Modal body content
</Modal>

interactionBehavior.summary: Canonical OneUI modal: a structured header / scrollable body / footer over a `--Scrim` backdrop. Default `modal={true}` traps focus, locks page scroll, and inerts the rest of the page. `dismissible` (default true) is stricter than Dialog — it blocks Escape, outside-press, and focus-out together, while the header close `IconButton` still always works. The close control lives in the header, so `header={false}` also removes that button. On open/close the backdrop fades its `opacity` while the popup fades and scales — from `scale(0.9)` up to rest — together: opening runs `--Motion-Duration-L` / `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate`, closing the faster `--Motion-Duration-M` / `--Motion-Easing-Exit-Moderate`. `prefers-reduced-motion` drops the scale and keeps an opacity-only fade on Subtle tokens.
press: A press on the `--Scrim` backdrop closes the modal (`reason: "outside-press"`) when `dismissible` is true.
`dismissible={false}` sets `disablePointerDismissal` and cancels `outside-press`, `escape-key`, and `focus-out`. The header close control still fires `reason: "close-press"`.
The close control is an `IconButton` (`attention="low"`, `appearance="neutral"`, `aria-label="Close"`), so its press fill comes from IconButton, not Modal CSS.
The popup itself has no press-scale or press-fill; only slotted actions and the close IconButton respond.
focus: Default `modal={true}` traps focus, locks document scroll, and mounts Base UI's internal inert layer over the page. `modal={false}` keeps pointer behaviour without scroll-lock or inert; `modal="trap-focus"` traps focus without the rest.

Initial focus follows Base UI: first tabbable descendant, or the popup itself on a touch open (to keep the virtual keyboard closed). Closing restores focus to the trigger unless you pass `finalFocus`.
The scrollable body is `tabIndex={0}` so keyboard users can focus it and scroll without a nested interactive child.
Body `:focus-visible` is a single inset `--Focus-Outline` ring, not the two-layer halo. The close IconButton uses IconButton's inner `--Surface-Halo-Gap` + outer `--Focus-Outline` halo.
Mouse clicks do not paint the body ring — it is `:focus-visible` only.
keyboard: `Escape` closes with `reason: "escape-key"` when `dismissible` is true, and is cancelled (no `onOpenChange`) when `dismissible={false}`.
`Tab` cycles inside the trap. The body is a tab stop so overflowing content can be scrolled from the keyboard.
There is no OneUI arrow-key handling inside the modal.
